newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai private firms to provide 100,000 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai private firms to provide 100,000 jobs.

text.p: Private enterprises in Shanghai over the next three years will provide 100,000-to-150,000 jobs for people laid off from state firms, the Business News said on Friday.

By the end of October, Shanghai's 210,600 private firms employed 760,000 people, accounting for 16.5 percent of the city's workforce and including 207,000 people laid off from state firms, the newspaper said.
The city government has decided to give tax benefits to these private firms to encourage them to take on a large number of former state workers, it said without elaborating.
